0022600225.text: The Houston Rockets host the Golden State Warriors in the Rockets' 12th game of the 2026-27 season, with both teams at 8-3. Houston is 5-1 at home, holds a W1 streak and a 7-3 record over its last ten, and sits 2nd in the Southwest, 1 game back, and 6th in the West. Golden State is on an W8 streak with an 8-2 record over its last ten, sits 2nd in the Pacific, 1.5 games back, and is 4th in the West. Houston is missing Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain), while Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Will Richard (thumb), and Brandon Williams (hamstring) and Gary Payton II (knee inflammation) are day-to-day. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Rockets won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 117-116 regular-season win in San Francisco on April 5, 2026.
